confirm.heading: Install the orchestra in {0}?
confirm.intro: The orchestra lets AI agents work through the project's GitHub issues for you. A conductor picks issues by priority, hands them to agents working in parallel in their own copies, reviews the result and delivers it. Questions only you can answer land on the issue, not in the chat.
confirm.addsDetail: a pinned copy of the orchestra's instructions, a project policy with your rules and the /orkester command for Claude and Codex.
confirm.readmore.name: Read more about the orchestra on GitHub
confirm.readmore: Read more about the Conductor and the orchestra
confirm.summary: The chosen AI ({0}) starts in a new tab with {1}, reads the project and asks you about language, publishing and working rules before it writes the policy. Nothing is committed until you have approved.

prompt.install: Install the Conductor and the orchestra in this project. Follow INSTALL.md in https://github.com/solwation/dirigenten-och-orkestern: the latest release as a git subtree under .orchestra/shared, a project policy in .orchestra/project.md based on PROJECT.example.md, the /orkester command for Claude (.claude/commands/orkester.md) and the Codex skill (.agents/skills/orkester/SKILL.md), linked from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Read the project first and ask me about language, publishing, capacity and timers before you write the policy. Commit once I have approved. Answer in English.
denied.offer: agy denied {0} in {1} (Run once cannot ask). Add exceptions to agy's settings?
denied.allow.tip: Adds {1} under permissions.allow in {0} and runs the affected tabs again
restart.tip: Open the tab again with the same AI, model and orchestra choice
restart.continue.name: Continue the latest conversation
restart.continue.tip: Open the tab and continue the latest conversation in its directory. No new orchestra prompt is sent. Tabs in the same directory share the latest conversation.
restart.shell.tip: Open the shell tab again. A shell has no AI conversation to continue.
restart.name: Restart the tab
settings.minimizeToTray: Close and minimize to the system tray
settings.minimizeToTray.tip: The close button and Minimize put BoosterAI in the system tray (Windows) instead of quitting or staying in the taskbar. Quit from the icon's menu
settings.notifications.tip: Notify when a tab closes, does not start or its CLI fails
settings.updates.tip: Ask GitHub at start, when the window gets focus and every five minutes while it is active whether a newer version exists (now {0})
settings.cliUpdates.tip: Update claude, codex and agy in the tab before they start when a newer version exists, at most every six hours per CLI. A failure never stops the start.
settings.autoClear.name: Idle minutes before auto-clear
settings.autoClear.tip: Send /clear to claude in a tab that has been idle this long, once per idle period, so the next prompt starts with an empty context. Applies to tabs started or restarted after it is turned on. Never when you have typed something since the turn began, and never for Run once, codex or agy.
update.manual: Version {0} is available – this copy cannot update itself.
update.install.tip: Downloads {0}, checks it against SHA256SUMS and restarts BoosterAI. Open tabs keep running but are no longer watched.
update.more.name: Show all changes in the new version on GitHub
update.error.checksum: the checksum of {0} does not match

restartAll.name: Restart all tabs
restartAll.tip: Restart every tab that can be restarted. Tabs working on a turn are asked about once.
restartConfirm.busyMany: Several CLIs are working right now. Restarting now interrupts what they are doing. The other tabs restart right away either way.
restartConfirm.unknownMany: BoosterAI cannot tell whether these CLIs are working right now. Restarting interrupts anything they may be doing. The other tabs restart right away either way.
close.title: Close all
close.confirm: Active AI turns will be interrupted. Each AI then continues the latest conversation in its directory to save, commit and push completed work. Tabs close after that turn. Permissions can prevent saving. Shells and finished one-shot runs close immediately. Continue?
close.waiting: Agents are saving their work. Force close stops them immediately and can lose unsaved work. Cancel stops further closing; save turns already started may continue.
close.timeout: 10 minutes have passed. Some tabs are still open. Force close them now, or cancel and check them in the terminal.
close.noTrack: Cannot verify this tab’s process. Check the terminal manually.
close.ambiguous: Multiple tabs share this AI and directory. The latest conversation is ambiguous. Save manually, cancel or force close.
close.saveFailed: The save turn failed or was denied. Check the terminal before forcing it closed.
